name: cosmic_electrons
line: High-energy electrons from space, studied for spectral features to distinguish astrophysical sources.

name: positron_fraction
line: Ratio of positrons to total electrons plus positrons in cosmic rays, rising above 10 GeV.

name: transport_equation
line: Equation describing propagation of cosmic rays through the interstellar medium.

name: secondary_positrons
line: Positrons produced by interactions of primary cosmic rays with interstellar gas.

name: pulsar
line: Rotating neutron star emitting beams of radiation, a candidate source of cosmic electrons.

name: dark_matter_annihilation
line: Hypothetical process where dark matter particles annihilate into standard particles, including electrons.

name: atic
line: Balloon-borne experiment measuring cosmic ray electron spectra with high precision.

name: electron_spectrum
line: Distribution of electron flux as a function of energy, revealing spectral features.

name: fine_structure
line: Small-scale peaks and dips in the cosmic electron spectrum, indicative of nearby sources.

name: gigaelectronvolt
line: Unit of energy equal to one billion electronvolts, used for cosmic ray energies.
